Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. Management detailed agenda items including the adoption of audited financial statements and the re-appointment of directors and independent directors. The document outlines procedures for remote e-voting and participation via video conferencing facilities provided by NSDL. California Software Company Limited focused its strategy in FY 2024-25 on empowering small and microbusinesses through artificial intelligence and expanding its ecosystem of platforms like dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo. The company navigated the period by providing affordable, AI-driven solutions to help small enterprises improve efficiency, e-commerce operations, marketing, and customer service.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted an unprecedented surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally.
demand_outlook.quote: The past year witnessed an unprecedented surge in AI adoption among small businesses globally.

demand_outlook.claim: About 68 percent of small business owners reported using AI during the period.
demand_outlook.quote: About 68% of small business owners report already using AI, up sharply from 51% just two years prior.

demand_outlook.claim: An additional 9 percent of small business owners planned to begin using AI within the next year.
demand_outlook.quote: An additional 9% plan to begin using AI within the next year, indicating that roughly three-quarters of small firms will soon be AI-powered.

demand_outlook.claim: Around 80 percent of small business owners stated that AI enhances rather than replaces their workforce.
demand_outlook.quote: around 80% say AI is enhancing (not replacing) their workforce, and nearly 40% plan to create new jobs in 2025 because of AI-driven productivity gains.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 80 percent of small businesses adopting AI reported increased efficiency and productivity.
demand_outlook.quote: Surveys also show over 80% of small businesses adopting AI have increased efficiency and productivity, and more than half report AI provides better data for decision-making and new capabilities for expansion.

demand_outlook.claim: Generative AI usage among SMBs grew to 58 percent in 2025 from 40 percent in 2024.
demand_outlook.quote: 58% of SMBs reported using generative AI in 2025, up from 40% in 2024, with marketing as the top use case (U.S. Chamber Report).

orders_capacity.claim: Calsoft's digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants with high client retention.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Many small enterprises still faced resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry surveys noted that 42 percent of small businesses reported lacking necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: These efforts were aimed at closing the “resource and information gap” noted in industry surveys (e.g. 42% of small businesses reported not having the necessary expertise or resources to deploy AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah is re-appointed as an Independent Director for a second term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: be and is hereby re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan is re-appointed as a Director for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31, 2026 up to July 30, 2031.
management_commitments.quote: be and is hereby re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a commitment to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: As we look ahead, Calsofts remains committed to building an AI ecosystem that uplifts millions of entrepreneurs, ensuring that innovation is not just for the few, but for the many.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to continuing to embed supply chain AI capabilities into company offerings.
management_commitments.quote: Calsoft’s commitment is to continue embedding these supply chain AI capabilities into our offerings, so that even the smallest manufacturer or retailer can operate with world-class supply chain practices.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
